question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Huxley was an __exponent__ of Darwin’s theory of evolution.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Proponent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exponent"** means a person who supports an idea, theory, or cause and tries to persuade others of its value and importance. (समर्थक)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a leading exponent of modern art.
 
 
 
• **"Proponent"** refers to a person who advocates for or supports a theory, proposal, or course of action. (समर्थक)
 
 
• **Example: **He is a strong proponent of renewable energy sources.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'exponent'** is synonymous with **'proponent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cease** (रोकना): To stop or bring to an end.

 
 
• **Example:** The company will cease operations next month.
 
 
 
• **Terminate** (समाप्त करना): To bring something to an end.
 
 
• **Example: **The contract will terminate at the end of the year.
 
 
 
• **Conclude** (निष्कर्ष निकालना): To bring to an end, especially in a formal way.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting concluded with a vote of thanks.
